tagline: Popular PvP and utility Minecraft client with built-in addons and performance boosts
description: LabyMod is a well-known German client for Minecraft Java Edition combining FPS optimization, PvP HUD widgets, an in-game addon store, voice chat, friend system, and deep interface customization.
features: Built-in addon manager and customizable HUD widgets
Integrated voice chat, friend list, and server features
Supports modern and classic Minecraft Java Edition versions
